id: The Last Skram Gig? A Fundraiser For Henry-San Fran, Wellington-Ticket Master
name: The Last Skram Gig? A Fundraiser For Henry
long_description:
Theatrical indie pop group Skram are bringing an electric, emotional show to Pōneke at San Fran. With Henry off to London 3 days later, this night will be Skram’s most thunderous set yet, featuring tracks from their entire discography and a Skramily fun filled show full of surprises and twists. 
Will this be Skram’s last gig? Will it be their last gig in Aotearoa? Who knows… You’ll have to come along to find out.
This night is also featuring the stunning powerhouse and friend of Skram Jade Merematira, exciting new indie pop band Wildflower and the fusion hip hop energy of solo artist Zac McLean. 
This is Henry’s final fundraiser for their trip to London to study Musical Theatre at prestigious drama school - LAMDA. All proceeds go towards their significant tuition + moving and living costs.

San Fran holds a Supervised License. Minors are welcome to attend events at San Fran so long as they are accompanied by a legal guardian at all times whilst at the venue

id: KITA / LOVE LIVES HERE: 愛住在這裡-San Fran, Wellington-Ticket Master
name: KITA / LOVE LIVES HERE: 愛住在這裡
long_description:
Melding inspirations of folk, soul, pop and psychedelia with the guitar and spirited storytelling of musician-actor Nikita 雅涵 Tu-Bryant (Avatar 2, Far North); the thick  lushness of Moog synth and Fender Rhodes from Ed Zuccollo (aka Zuke); and the filthy  drive and barking drums of Rick Cranson (Little Bushman), KITA have long-since  solidified themselves as a must-see live band with a massive sound.
Front-woman Nikita 雅涵 Tu-Bryant is amidst her Artist in Residence at The Hannah Theatre in Wellington, translating her debut art-house film "LOVE LIVES HERE 愛住在這裡" for stage. The narrative originally inspired by the band's EP LOVE LIVES HERE which they toured nationwide in 2023. Tu-Bryant is debuting the film into a full immersive cinema-live-theatrical experience with a chorus of dancers and live band for her residency at the end of this year. In the meantime, she revives the live-in-concert version of this vulnerable ambitious work-in-progress. Excerpts from the film will be remixed live by Elfling. This show was showcased at Twisted Frequency, and now powerhouse trio KITA bring it back to the capital playing one of their favourite venues in Pōneke. 

Support act to be revealed beginning of September

San Fran holds a Supervised License. Minors are welcome to attend events at San Fran so long as they are accompanied by a legal guardian at all times whilst at the venue.

name: Two Psychics and a Medium
venue: The Opera House Wellington, Wellington, NZ
long_description:
All Tickets are Mobile Ticket Only. 
Mobile Tickets are like Print-at-Home tickets but instead of having to print off the tickets yourself, you can just show the barcode on your mobile phone. It is the easiest way to access tickets to your events. For more information visit Ticketmaster.co.nz/mobileticket

Child Policy: This event is recommended for ages 16+


Please note: There is no elevator in the Opera House and access to the Dress Circle and Gallery are via stairs. The Gallery may be unsuitable for patrons with accessibility requirements or experience vertigo. For further information, please contact us on 04 916 1205.

As this is a live, unscripted theatre experience, the presenters have no control over the information received during audience readings. Messages may occasionally include references to sensitive or traumatic events, including grief, loss, illness, accidents, violence, homicide or suicide.
